PART 01 · WORD COMPARISONS

Word Comparisons · 153 groups

01insert / plug

insert

To put something inside or between other things.

plug

To connect a device to a socket, or fill a hole.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

insert / plug · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
insertv. 插入；嵌入

强调把东西放进内部或间隙

insert A into B
Insert the card into the slot.
将卡插入卡槽。
plugv. 插接；堵住

强调接通设备，或封住孔洞

plug in; plug a hole
Plug the cable into the socket.
把电缆插入插座。
Key differences & usage

insert 强调插入某处；plug 强调插接或堵住，常用 plug A into B、plug in。

Insert the card. / Plug the charger into the socket.
插入卡片。／把充电器插进插座。
Common collocations & patterns

insert A into B 把A插入B；plug a hole 堵洞；plug in a device 给设备接上电源；unplug 拔掉插头。

Common pitfalls

insert 注重放入动作，不保证接通电源。代词作 plug in 的宾语时常说 plug it in，不说 plug in it。

Insert the key into the lock, then plug the lamp in.
把钥匙插入锁中，然后给灯接上电源。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

要强调“放进去”用 insert；强调“插电或堵洞”用 plug。plug it in 中代词放在动词与 in 之间。

02expensive / prohibitive

expensive

Costing a lot of money.

prohibitive

So expensive that it prevents people from buying or doing something.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

expensive / prohibitive · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
expensiveadj. 昂贵的

价格高，未必高到无法接受

an expensive watch
This watch is expensive.
这块表很贵。
prohibitiveadj. 高得令人却步的

费用成为购买或行动的障碍

prohibitive costs
The cost of repairs was prohibitive.
修理费高得难以承受。
Key differences & usage

expensive 表示昂贵；prohibitive 表示费用高到足以阻止人购买或采取行动。

The hotel is expensive, but the flight cost is prohibitive.
酒店很贵，但机票费用更是高得难以承受。
Common collocations & patterns

an expensive mistake 代价高昂的错误；prohibitive costs 高得令人却步的成本；prohibit sb from doing 禁止某人做。

Common pitfalls

expensive 可以只是“贵但买得起”；prohibitive 强调价格构成障碍。prohibitive 也可指具有禁止性质的，但费用义很常见。

The fees are high for me, but not prohibitive.
费用对我而言很贵，但还没有贵到负担不起。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

只是说价格高用 expensive；高到使人放弃用 prohibitive。后者不是单纯更高级的 expensive，而是多了一层阻碍行动的含义。

03penalize / punish

penalize

To impose a penalty or put someone at a disadvantage.

punish

To make someone suffer a penalty for doing something wrong.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

penalize / punish · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
penalizev. 处罚；使吃亏

按规则扣分、处罚，或使处于不利地位

penalize sb for sth
They penalized him for arriving late.
他们因他迟到而处罚他。
punishv. 惩罚

对错误或不当行为施加惩罚，范围更广

punish sb for doing
He was punished for cheating.
他因作弊受罚。
Key differences & usage

punish 泛指惩罚；penalize 常指按规则处罚、扣分，也指使处于不利地位。

Players are penalized for breaking the rules.
球员违规会受罚。
Common collocations & patterns

penalize sb for sth 因某事处罚某人；punish sb for doing 因某行为惩罚某人；punishment 惩罚；penalty 处罚。

Common pitfalls

penalize 也指不公平地使某群体吃亏，不一定真的执行处罚；punish 可以来自家长、法院等，不只规则扣分。

The scoring system penalizes slow answers.
这套计分制度会使回答慢的人吃亏。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

规则扣分、处罚或制度让人吃亏时优先考虑 penalize；一般惩罚用 punish。两者都常接 for 表示处罚原因。

04drop / drip

drop

To fall, let something fall, or decrease in amount; a small amount of liquid.

drip

To fall or flow in small, separate drops.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

drop / drip · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
dropv./n. 落下；下降；一滴

可指一次掉落，也可指数量减少

drop a glass; a drop in prices
I dropped my phone.
我把手机掉在地上了。
dripv./n. 滴落；滴水声

突出液体一滴一滴地流出

drip from; a dripping tap
Water dripped from the ceiling.
水从天花板上滴下来。
Key differences & usage

drop 可表示落下、使落下或下降；drip 强调液体连续一滴滴落下。

Prices dropped. / The tap is dripping.
价格下降了。／水龙头在滴水。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

手机掉落、价格下跌用 drop；水龙头持续滴水用 drip。a drop of water 是一滴水；a drip 可指滴落声或滴漏。

05profit / interest / benefit

profit

Money left after costs are paid; to gain an advantage.

interest

Money paid for borrowing or saving money; a desire to know more.

benefit

An advantage or helpful effect; to help or gain from something.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

profit / interest / benefit · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
profitn./v. 利润；获益

商业中常指收入扣去成本后的余额

make a profit; profit from
The shop made a profit.
这家店盈利了。
interestn. 利息；兴趣

金融中是借贷资金的费用或收益；也指兴趣

pay interest; interest in
The bank pays interest on savings.
银行支付储蓄利息。
benefitn./v. 好处；受益

对健康、学习、生活等产生的正面作用

benefit from; be of benefit to
Exercise benefits your health.
锻炼有益健康。
Key differences & usage

profit 常指扣除成本后的利润；interest 在金融中指利息；benefit 指更广泛的好处。

The business made a profit; the bank paid interest.
企业赚了利润；银行支付了利息。
Common collocations & patterns

make a profit 获利；pay interest on a loan 支付贷款利息；benefit from 从中受益；be of benefit to 对……有益。

Common pitfalls

interest 还指兴趣；interests 可指利益。benefit 可作动词，benefit sb 和 benefit from sth 方向不同。

Students benefit from the scheme, even though it makes no profit.
尽管这项计划不盈利，学生仍能从中受益。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

问“赚了多少”常用 profit；借贷产生的利息用 interest；广义好处用 benefit。benefit sb 是使某人受益，benefit from 是从某事中受益。

06spin / revolve / rotate / wheel

spin

To turn around quickly; also to make thread or present a particular version of events.

revolve

To turn around a central point or axis; to have something as the main focus.

rotate

To turn around an axis or take turns in a regular order.

wheel

A circular part that turns on an axle; to move something on wheels, or turn and move in a curve or circle.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

spin / revolve / rotate / wheel · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
spinv./n. 快速旋转

突出快速转动；也可指纺纱或编造说法

spin around; spin a story
The wheel was spinning fast.
轮子正在快速旋转。
revolvev. 围绕转动

可绕中心运行，也可绕自身轴转动；并非只表示公转

revolve around; revolve on an axis
The discussion revolves around costs.
讨论围绕成本展开。
rotatev. 旋转；轮换

绕轴转动或按顺序轮换，不必很快

rotate on an axis; rotate duties
Rotate the image clockwise.
将图片顺时针旋转。
wheeln./v. 车轮；推着轮式物体移动；盘旋转向

名词指轮子；动词可指推着有轮子的物体走，或人、鸟等转身、盘旋移动，强调运动路径而非单纯绕轴自转

a bicycle wheel; wheel a suitcase; wheel around; birds wheeling overhead
Birds wheeled above the cliffs.
鸟儿在悬崖上空盘旋。

wheel 作动词可指推着轮式物体移动或盘旋转向；revolve 也能绕自身轴转动，不能只按自转和公转二分。

Key differences & usage

spin 常强调快速自转；revolve 常指围绕中心转动；rotate 可指绕轴旋转或轮流。并非绝对互斥。

Earth rotates on its axis and revolves around the Sun.
地球自转，同时绕太阳公转。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

快速转动常用 spin，围绕中心运行常用 revolve，绕轴转动或轮换常用 rotate；这些用法有重叠。wheel 作名词是“轮子”，作动词则常描写推着轮式物体移动（wheel a suitcase），或盘旋、转身（birds wheel overhead / wheel around）。The wheel spins 是“轮子快速旋转”，第一个 wheel 是名词；不能把动词 wheel 机械替换成所有“自转”的说法。 revolve 也能描述绕轴自转，如 a revolving door；“revolve 只指公转、rotate 只指自转”不是普遍规则。

07vapor / steam

vapor

The gas form of a substance that can also be liquid or solid.

steam

Water in its gas form, also used for the visible mist above hot water; to cook with steam.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

vapor / steam · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
vaporn. 蒸气

物质处于气态的形式，不限于水；英式 vapour

water vapor; fuel vapor
Water vapor is invisible.
水蒸气是看不见的。
steamn./v. 水蒸气；蒸

特指水的蒸气；日常也称可见白雾为 steam

steam vegetables; a steam engine
Steam the vegetables for five minutes.
把蔬菜蒸五分钟。
Key differences & usage

vapor（英式 vapour）泛指蒸气；steam 特指水蒸气，日常也用来称呼热水上方可见的白雾。

The air contains water vapor. / Steam rose from the kettle.
空气中含有水蒸气。／水壶冒出蒸汽。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

vapor 范围比 steam 广。严格说可见白雾由细小水滴构成，但日常说 steam rose from the kettle 很自然；科学语境要分清物态。

08argument / point / argumentation

argument

Reasons supporting an opinion, or an angry disagreement.

point

A particular idea, opinion, or important detail in a discussion.

argumentation

The process of developing and presenting reasons for a position.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

argument / point / argumentation · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
argumentn. 论据；论证；争吵

可以是一套理由，也可以是人与人争执

an argument for/against; have an argument
Her argument is supported by evidence.
她的论证有证据支持。
pointn. 要点；观点

讨论中的一个具体想法，不一定包含完整论证

make a point; the main point
You made a good point.
你提出了一个很好的观点。
argumentationn. 论证过程或方法

正式、学术用语，强调组织理由的方式

logical argumentation
The essay lacks clear argumentation.
这篇文章缺少清晰的论证。
Key differences & usage

point 是某个要点或观点；argument 是支持结论的一套理由，也可指争吵；argumentation 是展开论证的过程或方法。

Your point is clear, but your argument needs evidence.
你的观点很清楚，但论证需要证据。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

一个讨论要点是 point；支撑结论的理由可以是 argument；组织并展开论证的过程是 argumentation。argument 不一定是争吵，需看搭配。

09disorder / disturbance

disorder

A lack of order, or a condition affecting normal functioning.

disturbance

Something that interrupts peace, order, or normal activity.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

disorder / disturbance · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
disordern. 混乱；失调；障碍

状态或某类功能异常，不必是一次事件

in disorder; a sleep disorder
The papers were in disorder.
文件杂乱无章。
disturbancen. 打扰；干扰；骚乱

原有平静或正常活动受到扰动

cause a disturbance
The noise caused a disturbance.
噪声造成了干扰。
Key differences & usage

disorder 指混乱、失调或某种障碍；disturbance 可指打扰、干扰或骚乱，也可指功能或状态的紊乱。

a sleep disorder / a noise disturbance
睡眠障碍／噪声干扰

Usage notes & common pitfalls

disorder 可指无序状态、疾病或功能障碍；disturbance 可指打扰事件，也可指功能或状态的紊乱，如 sleep disturbance。不能硬分成“长期状态”和“一次事件”。

10exclaim / yell / shout

exclaim

To speak suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion.

yell

To make a loud cry or speak very loudly.

shout

To speak or call out in a loud voice.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

exclaim / yell / shout · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
exclaimv. 惊呼；大声说

强调情绪引发的突然表达，未必持续大喊

exclaim in surprise
“What a view!” she exclaimed.
“景色真美！”她惊叹道。
yellv./n. 大喊

常带强烈情绪，也可为让远处的人听见

yell at; yell for help
He yelled for help.
他大声呼救。
shoutv./n. 喊叫

提高音量，可传递信息、呼救或争吵

shout to/at sb
She shouted to us across the river.
她隔着河向我们喊话。
Key differences & usage

exclaim 强调因情绪突然说出；yell 强调大声喊叫；shout 是较中性的大声喊。yell 和 shout 经常重叠。

“Amazing!” she exclaimed. / He shouted for help.
“太棒了！”她惊呼。／他大声呼救。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

惊讶地脱口而出用 exclaim；提高音量用 shout/yell。shout at 常有对人怒喊的意味，shout to 常为让远处的人听见，但仍需看上下文。

11transcript / counterpart

transcript

A written record of speech, or an official record of academic results.

counterpart

A person or thing with a similar role in another place or situation.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

transcript / counterpart · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
transcriptn. 文字转录；成绩单

语音的文字记录，或课程成绩记录

a transcript of; an academic transcript
I read the interview transcript.
我读了采访的文字稿。
counterpartn. 对应的人或物

在另一个组织或场景中承担相似职能者

one's counterpart in; a foreign counterpart
She met her French counterpart.
她会见了法国的同职同行。
Key differences & usage

两词不近义：transcript 是文字转录或成绩单；counterpart 是另一组织或环境中职能相当的人或物。

an academic transcript / her French counterpart
一份成绩单／与她职位相当的法国同行

Usage notes & common pitfalls

这两个词不是近义词。要找录音文字稿或成绩记录选 transcript；要描述“另一地区的同职人员或同类事物”选 counterpart。

12jam / block

jam

To become stuck or crowded so that movement is difficult.

block

To prevent movement, access, or progress by putting something in the way.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

jam / block · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
jamv./n. 卡住；拥堵

突出物品挤在一起或机器无法运转

a paper jam; a traffic jam
The paper jammed in the printer.
纸卡在打印机里了。
blockv./n. 阻挡；障碍物

挡住通道、视线、进入或进展

block the way; block access
A fallen tree blocked the road.
倒下的树挡住了道路。
Key differences & usage

jam 常指机器卡住或拥堵；block 强调阻挡通道或阻止进入。

The printer jammed. / A truck blocked the road.
打印机卡住了。／卡车堵住了路。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

打印机卡纸、交通拥堵常用 jam；道路、入口或视线被挡住常用 block。The door is jammed 侧重门卡死，The door is blocked 侧重门口被堵。

13appoint / arrange

appoint

To officially choose someone for a role or set a time or place.

arrange

To plan something or put things in a particular order.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

appoint / arrange · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
appointv. 任命；指定

赋予职位，或正式确定时间地点

appoint sb as/to; appoint a time
They appointed her as director.
他们任命她为主任。
arrangev. 安排；筹备；整理

组织活动或把东西按顺序摆放

arrange to do; arrange for sb to do
We arranged for a taxi to collect her.
我们安排出租车去接她。
Key differences & usage

appoint 常指任命，也可正式地指定时间地点；arrange 常指安排活动、筹备或整理。预约一般说 arrange a meeting 或 make an appointment。

They appointed her manager. / We arranged a meeting.
他们任命她为经理。／我们安排了会议。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

任命人到职位用 appoint；安排会议、交通和活动用 arrange。arrange for sb to do 很常见；不要把“预约”机械译为 appoint a meeting。

14smell / odor

smell

To notice an odor with your nose; an odor itself.

odor

A particular smell, often a strong or unpleasant one.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

smell / odor · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
smelln./v. 气味；闻

通用词，可作感官动词，气味可好可坏

smell of; smell good
The bread smells wonderful.
面包闻起来很香。
odorn. 气味

较正式，常见于描述强烈或不悦气味；英式 odour

a strong odor; body odor
There was a strange odor in the room.
房间里有股奇怪的气味。
Key differences & usage

smell 是常用的气味名词，也可作动词“闻”；odor（英式 odour）是名词，较正式，常用于明显或难闻的气味，但不一定难闻。

I can smell coffee. / a strong odor
我闻到咖啡味。／一股浓烈气味

Usage notes & common pitfalls

smell 可作名词也可作动词；odor 通常只作名词。感官系动词 smell 后常接形容词：smell good，而不是用 well 表示“闻起来很好”。

15institute / institution

institute

An organization for specialized work or study; to introduce a system or practice.

institution

An established organization, social system, or custom.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

institute / institution · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
instituten./v. 研究所；实行

名词常指专业研究教育机构；动词指建立或开始实施

a research institute; institute reforms
They instituted new safety checks.
他们实行了新的安全检查。
institutionn. 机构；制度；习俗

范围广，既可指组织，也可指长期社会制度

a financial institution; the institution of marriage
Marriage is a social institution.
婚姻是一种社会制度。
Key differences & usage

institute 作名词多指研究或教育机构，作动词指建立、实行；institution 范围更广，涵盖机构、制度或社会习俗。

a research institute / a financial institution
研究所／金融机构

Usage notes & common pitfalls

专业研究机构常叫 institute，但应尊重机构正式名称。institution 可描述银行、学校等组织，也能描述婚姻等制度，不能只理解为一个建筑。

16analytic / analytical

analytic

Using analysis; often used in technical or academic terms.

analytical

Examining things carefully by considering their parts and relationships.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

analytic / analytical · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
analyticadj. 分析的

常见于学科术语，与 analytical 有大量重叠

analytic philosophy; analytic geometry
She studies analytic philosophy.
她研究分析哲学。
analyticaladj. 分析的；善于分析的

常形容思维、技能、方法和人

analytical skills; an analytical approach
The task requires analytical skills.
这项任务需要分析能力。
Key differences & usage

都表示分析的，许多语境可互换。analytical 常见于能力、思维；analytic 常见于特定学术搭配。不要硬分成两个截然不同的意思。

分析能力／分析哲学

Usage notes & common pitfalls

两词没有可靠的“理论与实践”二分。日常描述分析能力常用 analytical skills；学科术语按固定搭配记忆，两者许多场景可互换。

把报告浓缩为一页。

通过压力、编码等减少体积或占用空间

Key differences & usage

condense 指浓缩、缩写，也指气体凝结；compress 指压缩体积、文件或把内容挤进更短空间。

水蒸气凝结。／压缩文件。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

气体凝结用 condense；压缩文件、气体体积用 compress。缩短文章时两者都可能成立：condense 更突出浓缩要点，compress 更突出压入更短篇幅。

49motive / motivation

motive

A reason for a particular action.

motivation

The desire or drive to act, or the reasons behind an action.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

motive / motivation · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
motiven. 动机

具体行动背后的原因，调查语境常见但未必负面

a motive for; an ulterior motive
Her motive was to help others.
她的动机是帮助别人。
motivationn. 动力；动机

既可指行为原因，也常指行动积极性

motivation to do; lack motivation
I lack the motivation to study.
我缺乏学习动力。
Key differences & usage

motive 常指某次行为背后的具体动机，尤其调查语境；motivation 指动力、积极性或促使行为的原因，可与 motive 重叠。

a motive for the crime / motivation to study
犯罪动机／学习动力
Common collocations & patterns

a motive for doing 做某事的动机；an ulterior motive 隐藏的动机；motivation to learn 学习动力；lack motivation 缺乏积极性。

Common pitfalls

motive 常关注“为什么做了这件事”；motivation 也可问原因，但在学习、工作中常关注“有没有动力坚持”。motive 不必一定是坏的。

Her motive was to help, but she lacked the motivation to continue.
她的动机是帮助别人，但缺乏继续下去的动力。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

问一次行为的具体理由用 motive 很自然；问学习积极性用 motivation 更自然。motivation 也可指行为动机，不能把二者完全割裂。

related

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples

Key differences & usage

related 只表示有联系，也可指有亲属关系；relevant 表示与当前问题直接相关、有用。常用 related to、relevant to。

Common collocations & patterns

be relevant to the discussion 与讨论有关；relevant experience 相关经验；be related to 与……有关；closely related 密切相关。

Common pitfalls

related 强调存在联系；relevant 还强调对当前目的有关系或价值。两者常接 to，不能默认改为 with。

These two subjects are related, but only one is relevant to my essay.

Key differences & usage

quote 强调直接引用原话；cite 强调援引来源、证据或例子，不一定逐字引用。

Common pitfalls

quote 还有“报价”义；cite 可援引数据、案例、理由，不必复述原话。引用原话和标明来源是两个动作，可同时发生。

He cited the study without quoting any of its sentences.
他援引了这项研究，但没有逐字引用其中的句子。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

直接复制原话通常是 quote；交代依据来源通常是 cite。可以 cite 一项研究而完全不 quote 其原句，也可以同时做这两件事。

encouragev. 鼓励；促进

给予支持和信心，或使某行为更可能发生

encourage sb to do; encourage growth
She encouraged me to keep trying.
她鼓励我继续尝试。
Key differences & usage

prompt 作动词表示促使某人行动或引发反应；urge 强调强烈敦促；encourage 强调给予鼓励或支持。prompt 另可作形容词“及时的”和名词“提示”。

Common collocations & patterns

prompt sb to do 促使某人做；urge sb to do 敦促某人做；encourage sb to do 鼓励某人做；a prompt reply 及时回复；a writing prompt 写作提示

Common pitfalls

prompt 不只是AI“提示词”。The news prompted a debate 中意为消息引发了讨论；urge 的语气通常更急迫。

The question prompted me to think. / My teacher encouraged me to try again.
这个问题促使我思考。／老师鼓励我再试一次。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

引发行动用 prompt；强烈劝说用 urge；给予信心支持用 encourage。prompt 的及时义、提示义都很常见，不只用于AI提示词。

92borrow / lend

borrow

To take something temporarily with the intention of returning it.

lend

To let someone use something temporarily with the expectation of its return.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

borrow / lend · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
borrowv. 借入

主语暂时拿来别人的东西

Key differences & usage

borrow 从别人那里借入；lend 把自己的东西借给别人。二者描述同一借用关系的不同方向。borrowed 为规则过去式，lend 的过去式与过去分词为 lent。

borrow sth from sb 向某人借入；lend sth to sb / lend sb sth 借给某人；a library loan 图书借阅

不要说 borrow me a pen；应说 lend me a pen。表达借了多久常用 keep：May I keep it for a week? borrow 常强调借入动作。

Can I borrow your pen? / Could you lend me your pen?
我能借你的笔吗？／你能把笔借给我吗？

Usage notes & common pitfalls

借入用 borrow，借出用 lend。lend 的过去式是 lent；表达“保留借来的物品多久”常用 keep，例如 Can I keep it for a week?

merit

A quality deserving approval; as a verb, to be worthy of attention or a response.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

deserve / merit · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
deservev. 值得；应得

通用表达，可接名词或不定式；好坏结果都可应得

deserve praise; deserve to win; deserve punishment
You deserve to be treated with respect.
你应该受到尊重。
meritv. 值得；应受到

较正式，通常直接接名词，强调足以得到某种评价或关注

merit attention; merit consideration; merit further study
The issue merits further investigation.
这个问题值得进一步调查。

deserve 通用，既可 deserve praise 也可 deserve punishment；deserve to do / deserve to be done 常用。merit 较正式，merit attention / consideration / investigation 更典型；不要机械写成 merit to do。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

deserve 通用，既可 deserve praise 也可 deserve punishment；deserve to do / deserve to be done 常用。merit 较正式，merit attention / consideration / investigation 更典型；不要机械写成 merit to do。

153still / static / statical

still

Not moving or making a sound; as an adverb, continuing up to a time.

static

Not moving, developing or changing over time.

statical

Relating to statics; a less common form of static in technical use.

Word-by-word comparison

Swipe the table sideways to compare usage and examples.

still / static / statical · Usage comparison
Word / ExpressionMeaning & UsageCollocations / PatternsBilingual Examples
stilladj. 静止的；平静的

此处比较形容词：强调当下没有运动；副词 still 可表示仍然

keep still; stand still; still water
Keep still while I take the photo.
我拍照时请别动。
staticadj. 静态的；不变的

强调一段时间内状态、数值或系统没有变化

a static image; static prices; remain static
The population has remained static for years.
人口数量多年来一直没有变化。
staticaladj. 静力学的；静态的（少见）

多见于静力学等专业或较旧用法；日常静态通常用 static

statical equilibrium; statical analysis
The textbook discusses statical equilibrium.
这本教材讨论静力平衡。

still 强调当下不动；static 强调状态或数值不变。静态图片是 a static image；让人别动说 keep still。statical 不是 static 的副词，副词是 statically；statistical 才是统计的。statical 在专业语境可用，但多数日常场合优先 static。

Usage notes & common pitfalls

still 强调当下不动；static 强调状态或数值不变。静态图片是 a static image；让人别动说 keep still。statical 不是 static 的副词，副词是 statically；statistical 才是统计的。statical 在专业语境可用，但多数日常场合优先 static。

PART 02 · WORD MEANINGS

Word Meanings

75 words · 420 meanings · Common and extended uses

Common and selected specialist meanings, with usage labels and device pronunciation. Words with multiple pronunciations include contextual phrases.

P01credit 8 meanings

credit

1 n. 信用；赊购；信贷

Trust that allows someone to obtain goods or money and pay later.

We bought the furniture on credit.
我们赊购了这些家具。

2 n. 赞扬；功劳；认可

Praise or recognition for an achievement.

She deserves credit for solving the problem.
解决这个问题的功劳应归于她。

3 v. 将……归功于；认为具有

To recognize someone as responsible for something or possessing a quality.

He is credited with inventing the device.
这项装置的发明被归功于他。

4 n. 学分

A unit awarded for completing an academic course.

This course is worth three credits.
这门课程计三个学分。

5 n. 复数 片头或片尾演职员名单

A list naming the people who made a film or programme.

Her name appears in the closing credits.
她的名字出现在片尾演职员表中。

6 n. 账户贷记金额；可用余额

An amount added to an account or available to spend.

There is a credit of twenty dollars on your account.
你的账户上有二十美元的贷记余额。

7 v. 把钱记入账户

To add an amount of money to an account.

The bank credited the refund to my account.
银行把退款记入了我的账户。

8 v. 正式 相信；信以为真

To believe that something surprising is true.

I could hardly credit what I was hearing.
我几乎无法相信自己听到的话。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

on credit 赊购；give sb credit for 认可某人的贡献；to one's credit 值得赞扬的是；credit A to B 将A归功于B。credit card 信用卡，不等于 debit card 借记卡。

P02dash 6 meanings

dash

1 v./n. 猛冲；奔跑；短跑

To move suddenly and quickly; a quick run.

We made a dash for the last bus.
我们冲向了末班公交车。

2 n. 破折号

A punctuation mark used to separate or interrupt parts of a sentence.

Use a dash to introduce the explanation.
用破折号引出解释。

3 n. 少量；少许

A small amount added to something.

Add a dash of milk to the tea.
往茶里加少许牛奶。

4 v. 使希望等破灭

To destroy someone's hopes or expectations.

The cancellation dashed our hopes of travelling.
行程取消使我们出游的希望破灭了。

5 v. 猛摔；猛撞

To throw or strike something violently against a surface.

Waves dashed against the rocks.
海浪猛烈撞击着岩石。

6 n. 活力；气派

Energy, confidence, or stylish behaviour.

He played the role with great dash.
他把这个角色演得神采飞扬。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a dash of 少量；dash off 匆匆写下或迅速离开；dash one's hopes 使希望破灭。破折号 dash 与连字符 hyphen 不同。

P03recourse 2 meanings

recourse

1 n. 求助；诉诸某种手段

The act of turning to someone or something for help.

They settled the dispute without recourse to the courts.
他们没有诉诸法院就解决了争端。

2 n. 可依靠的办法；救济途径

A source of help or a way of obtaining a remedy.

Our only recourse was to appeal.
我们唯一的补救途径就是上诉。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

较正式，常为不可数名词。have recourse to 求助于；without recourse to 不借助；have no recourse but to do 除了做……别无办法。不要与 resource（资源）混淆。

P04fly 7 meanings

fly

1 v. 飞；乘飞机；驾驶飞机

To move through the air, travel by plane, or control an aircraft.

We flew to Shanghai yesterday.
我们昨天乘飞机去了上海。

2 n. 苍蝇

A small flying insect.

A fly landed on the window.
一只苍蝇落在窗户上。

3 v. 使飞起；悬挂或飘扬旗帜

To cause something to move or remain in the air.

Children were flying kites in the park.
孩子们在公园里放风筝。

4 v. 飞奔；迅速传开或消逝

To move, spread, or pass very quickly.

Time flies when you are having fun.
玩得开心时，时间过得飞快。

5 v. 非正式 被接受；行得通

To be accepted or considered workable.

That excuse will not fly with the teacher.
老师不会接受那个借口。

6 n. 裤子前面的开口或门襟

The opening at the front of a pair of trousers.

Your fly is open.
你的裤子门襟开了。

7 v. 逃离；逃避（较文学化）

To flee from danger or an unpleasant situation.

They were forced to fly the country.
他们被迫逃离那个国家。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

fly—flew—flown；fly to 飞往；fly a kite 放风筝；fly into a rage 勃然大怒；time flies 时间飞逝。苍蝇复数 flies。

P05drop 6 meanings

drop

1 v. 掉落；使落下

To fall or let something fall.

I dropped my phone on the floor.
我把手机掉在地板上了。

2 v./n. 下降；减少；降幅

To become lower in amount or level; a decrease.

There was a sharp drop in prices.
价格大幅下降。

3 n. 一滴；少量

A small rounded amount of liquid.

A drop of rain fell on my hand.
一滴雨落在我手上。

4 v. 放弃；取消；停止讨论

To stop doing, including, or discussing something.

They dropped the plan because of the cost.
他们因费用问题放弃了计划。

5 v. 让某人下车；送至某处

To take someone somewhere and leave them there.

Could you drop me at the station?
你能把我送到车站吗？

6 n. 落差；陡降距离

A vertical distance down from a surface.

There is a steep drop beyond the wall.
墙外有一处很陡的落差。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

drop—dropped—dropped；drop in 顺便拜访；drop out (of) 退出或辍学；drop off 送下车、减少或睡着；drop by 顺便来访。

P06glow 3 meanings

glow

1 v./n. 发柔光；微光

To produce a steady soft light; such light.

The embers glowed in the dark.
余烬在黑暗中发着微光。

2 v./n. 脸色红润；红光

To look warm and pink, often from health or emotion.

Her cheeks glowed after the run.
跑步后她双颊红润。

3 v./n. 洋溢喜悦；满足感

To show or feel strong pleasure or satisfaction.

He glowed with pride at the news.
听到消息，他满脸自豪。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

glow 指持续柔和的光，flash 指闪光，shine 范围更广。glow with pride 因自豪而容光焕发；a warm glow 温暖的光或满足感。

P07catch 9 meanings

catch

1 v. 接住；抓住；捕获

To stop and hold something moving, or capture someone or something.

She caught the ball with one hand.
她用一只手接住了球。

2 v. 赶上交通工具或活动

To reach something in time.

Hurry or we will not catch the train.
快点，不然我们赶不上火车。

3 v. 感染；染上

To become infected with an illness.

She caught a cold last week.
她上周感冒了。

4 v. 发现某人正在做某事

To discover someone doing something, often wrong.

He was caught cheating in the exam.
他考试作弊被发现了。

5 v. 听清；理解；注意到

To hear, understand, or notice something.

I did not catch your name.
我没听清你的名字。

6 n. 隐藏的问题；不利条件

A hidden disadvantage or condition that makes an offer less attractive.

The offer sounds good, but what is the catch?
这个提议听起来不错，但有什么隐藏条件？

7 n. 接球；捕获物；捕获量

An act of catching or the things caught.

The fishermen brought in a good catch.
渔民带回了不少渔获。

8 v. 钩住；夹住；卡住

To become trapped or attached accidentally.

My sleeve caught on a nail.
我的袖子被钉子钩住了。

9 n. 扣件；门窗搭扣

A small device used to fasten a door, window, or container.

The catch on the window is broken.
窗户上的搭扣坏了。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

catch—caught—caught；catch up with 赶上；catch on 流行或理解；catch one's eye 引起注意；catch a cold 感冒；catch fire 着火。

P08just 6 meanings

just

1 adv. 仅仅；只是

Only or simply.

I just want some water.
我只想喝点水。

2 adv. 刚刚；刚才

A very short time before now or another time.

I have just finished my homework.
我刚做完作业。

3 adv. 恰好；正好；完全

Exactly or precisely.

That is just what I needed.
那正是我需要的。

4 adv. 实在；简直（加强语气）

Used to emphasize a statement or request.

The view is just amazing.
景色简直太棒了。

5 adv. 勉强；差一点才

By a very small margin.

We just managed to catch the bus.
我们勉强赶上了公交车。

6 adj. 公正的；正当的

Fair, morally right, or deserved.

They demanded a just decision.
他们要求一个公正的决定。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

just now 刚才或此刻，按时态判断；just about 几乎；not just 不仅；just in case 以防万一。副词常放在所限定成分前。

P09throw 6 meanings

throw

1 v./n. 扔；投；投掷

To send something through the air with the hand; an act of doing so.

He threw the keys to me.
他把钥匙扔给了我。

2 v. 使突然陷入某种状态

To cause someone or something to enter a difficult state.

The news threw the team into confusion.
这个消息让团队陷入混乱。

3 v. 非正式 举办聚会

To organize a party.

They threw a party for her birthday.
他们为她举办了生日聚会。

4 v. 猛地移动或使处于某位置

To move something suddenly or forcefully.

She threw her arms around him.
她一下子张开双臂抱住了他。

5 v. 非正式 使困惑；使慌乱

To confuse or upset someone unexpectedly.

The unexpected question threw me.
那个意外的问题让我乱了阵脚。

6 n. 沙发毯；盖毯

A loose decorative covering for furniture.

She put a soft throw over the sofa.
她在沙发上铺了一条柔软的盖毯。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

throw—threw—thrown；throw away 扔掉；throw out 丢弃、逐出或提出；throw up 呕吐；throw oneself into 全身投入。

P10point 7 meanings

point

1 n. 要点；观点；目的

An idea, important detail, or purpose.

What is the main point of the article?
这篇文章的主要观点是什么？

2 v. 指向；指示

To direct a finger or object toward something.

She pointed to the exit.
她指了指出口。

3 n. 地点；时刻；阶段

A particular place, moment, or stage.

We have reached a turning point.
我们已经到了一个转折点。

4 n. 分数；积分；计量单位点

A unit used in scoring or measurement.

Our team won by two points.
我们队以两分优势获胜。

5 n. 尖端；尖头

The sharp end of an object.

The point of the needle is bent.
针尖弯了。

6 n. 小数点；几何中的点

A decimal mark or an exact position with no size.

The answer is three point five.
答案是三点五。

7 v. 削尖；朝向

To give something a sharp end, or face in a direction.

The arrow points north.
箭头指向北方。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

point out 指出；point to 指向或表明；at this point 此时；on the point of doing 即将；there is no point in doing 做……没有意义。

P11last 6 meanings

last

1 adj./det. 最近过去的；上一个的

Most recent before the present one.

I saw her last Friday.
我上周五见过她。

2 adj./det. 最后的；仅剩的

Coming after all others, or the only one remaining.

This is the last ticket.
这是最后一张票。

3 v. 持续；维持

To continue for a period of time.

The meeting lasted two hours.
会议持续了两个小时。

4 adv. 最后；最近一次

After everyone else, or on the most recent occasion.

When did you last see him?
你上次见他是什么时候？

5 n./pron. 最后的人或事物；末尾

The final person, thing, or part.

She was the last to leave.
她最后一个离开。

6 v. 耐用；够用

To remain usable or sufficient.

This food should last us three days.
这些食物应该够我们吃三天。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

last year 去年，通常不加 the；the last year 可指过去一年或最后一年；at last 终于；last but not least 最后但同样重要。last 作“持续”不及物。

P12page 4 meanings

page

1 n. 页；页面；网页

One side of a sheet in a book, or a screen-based document.

Read the passage on page ten.
阅读第十页上的文章。

2 n. 常用复数 报刊的某栏目或版面

A section of a newspaper or magazine.

The story appeared on the sports pages.
这则报道刊登在体育版。

3 v. 广播寻呼；呼叫

To call someone by an announcement or electronic message.

The airport paged the missing passenger.
机场广播呼叫了那位未到的乘客。

4 n. 侍童；青年侍从

A young attendant serving a person or institution.

A page carried the queen's train.
一名侍童托着王后的长裙后摆。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

on page 10 在第10页；turn the page 翻页或开启新篇章；a web page 网页；page through 翻阅。page number 页码。

P13pass 9 meanings

pass

1 v. 经过；越过；超过

To move past or beyond someone or something.

We passed the library on the way.
我们在路上经过了图书馆。

2 v. 通过考试、检查或法案

To succeed in a test, or formally approve something.

She passed her driving test.
她通过了驾驶考试。

3 v. 递给；传递

To give something to another person.

Please pass me the salt.
请把盐递给我。

4 v. 时间流逝；度过

For time to go by, or to spend time.

We played cards to pass the time.
我们打牌来消磨时间。

5 n. 通行证；票证

A document giving permission to enter or travel.

You need a visitor's pass to enter.
你需要访客通行证才能进入。

6 n. 体育 传球

An act of sending a ball to another player.

Her accurate pass created a scoring chance.
她精准的传球创造了一次得分机会。

7 v. 拒绝参与；暂不选择

To decline an opportunity or take no turn.

I will pass on dessert today.
我今天就不吃甜点了。

8 v. 去世（委婉语）

To die, often used with away.

Her grandfather passed away peacefully.
她的祖父安详地去世了。

9 n. 山口；山间通道

A route through or over mountains.

The mountain pass is closed in winter.
这个山口冬季封闭。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

pass—passed—passed，与 past（过去的、经过）区分；pass away 去世；pass out 昏倒；pass on 转交；pass by 经过。

P14over 7 meanings

over

1 prep. 超过；多于

More than a stated number or amount.

There were over a hundred people.
有一百多人。

2 prep./adv. 在……上方；越过

Above something or moving across it.

The bird flew over the wall.
鸟飞过了墙。

3 adj./adv. 结束的；完结

Finished or no longer happening.

The exam is over.
考试结束了。

4 prep. 关于；因为；对……有控制权

Concerning something, or expressing a cause or control.

They argued over money.
他们为钱争吵。

5 prep. 在……期间；贯穿一段时间

During a period of time.

We discussed it over lunch.
我们午饭时讨论了这件事。

6 adv. 翻转；从一边到另一边

Into a different position or onto the other side.

Turn the page over.
把这一页翻过来。

7 adv. 再一次；重新

Again or from the beginning.

Please start over.
请重新开始。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

over 不总表示垂直正上方；above 更侧重位置较高。over and over 反复；all over 到处、结束；think over 仔细考虑；get over 克服、康复。

P15break 7 meanings

break

1 v. 打破；折断；破裂

To separate into pieces or damage something by force.

Be careful not to break the glass.
小心别打碎玻璃杯。

2 n. 休息；短暂中断

A short pause in work or another activity.

Let's take a ten-minute break.
我们休息十分钟吧。

3 v. 打断；中止；改变连续状态

To interrupt an activity or state.

Her laugh broke the silence.
她的笑声打破了沉默。

4 v. 违背；违反

To fail to obey a rule, promise, or agreement.

He broke his promise.
他违背了诺言。

5 v. 破纪录；破解

To do better than a record or solve a code.

She broke the school record.
她打破了校纪录。

6 v. 消息传开；公开新闻

For news to become known, or to make it known.

The story broke this morning.
这件事今天早上传开了。

7 n. 裂口；断裂；机会

A gap or fracture, or a fortunate opportunity.

Getting that role was her big break.
获得那个角色是她事业的重大转机。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

break—broke—broken；break down 故障、崩溃或分解；break up 分手、解散；break into 闯入；break out 爆发；break through 突破。

P16taste 5 meanings

taste

1 n. 味道；味觉

The flavour of something or the sense that detects it.

The soup has a salty taste.
这汤有咸味。

2 v. 尝；尝起来

To test food with the mouth, or have a particular flavour.

The cake tastes delicious.
蛋糕尝起来很好吃。

3 n. 喜好；审美；品味

A person's preferences or judgment about quality and style.

She has excellent taste in music.
她的音乐品味很好。

4 n. 少量品尝；体验

A small sample or brief experience.

The trip gave me a taste of independence.
这次旅行让我初尝独立的滋味。

5 v. 体验；领略

To experience something, often for the first time.

The young team tasted victory at last.
这支年轻队伍终于尝到了胜利的滋味。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

taste 作“尝起来”是系动词，接形容词：taste good；have a taste for 爱好；to one's taste 合口味；a taste of 初次体验。

P17cross 6 meanings

cross

1 v. 穿过；横渡；越过

To move from one side of something to the other.

Look both ways before you cross the road.
过马路前要左右看看。

2 v. 交叉；使相交

To place things across each other.

He sat with his legs crossed.
他交叉双腿坐着。

3 n. 十字形；十字架；杂交品种

A shape made by intersecting lines, or a mixed breed.

Put a cross next to the wrong answer.
在错误答案旁画一个叉。

4 adj. 尤其英式 生气的；恼怒的

Annoyed or angry.

She was cross with me for being late.
她因为我迟到而生我的气。

5 v. 反对；违背

To oppose or disobey someone.

You should not cross her when she is angry.
她生气时，你最好别跟她作对。

6 v. 使杂交

To breed plants or animals of different types together.

They crossed two varieties of rose.
他们将两个品种的玫瑰进行了杂交。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

cross the road 是动词；go across the road 中 across 是介词。cross out 划掉；come across 偶遇；keep one's fingers crossed 祈求好运。

P18shuttle 4 meanings

shuttle

1 n. 往返交通工具；接驳班车

A vehicle that repeatedly travels between two places.

A free shuttle runs to the airport.
有免费接驳车往返机场。

2 v. 往返运送；穿梭

To move or transport people regularly between places.

Buses shuttle visitors between the two buildings.
公交车往返两栋楼运送访客。

3 n. 航天飞机（space shuttle）

A spacecraft designed for repeated journeys between Earth and space.

The space shuttle returned safely.
航天飞机安全返回了。

4 n. 梭子；羽毛球（较少见，通常 shuttlecock）

A weaving tool carrying thread, or a shuttlecock.

The shuttle carries thread across the loom.
梭子把线送过织布机。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a shuttle bus 往返接驳车；space shuttle 航天飞机；shuttle between A and B 在两地间往返。

P19lie 6 meanings

lie

1 v. 躺；平卧

To be or rest in a horizontal position.

He lay on the sofa all afternoon.
他整个下午都躺在沙发上。

2 v. 说谎

To deliberately say something untrue.

She lied about her age.
她谎报了自己的年龄。

3 n. 谎言

A statement intended to deceive.

He told a lie to avoid trouble.
他为避免麻烦撒了谎。

4 v. 位于；处在某位置或状态

To be situated somewhere or remain in a state.

The village lies beside a river.
村庄位于一条河边。

5 v. 在于；存在于

To have its basis or cause in something.

The problem lies in the lack of practice.
问题在于缺少练习。

6 n. 所处位置或地形情况

The position of something, especially a golf ball or the land.

The ball had a difficult lie in the rough.
球落在长草区一个很难打的位置。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

躺／位于：lie—lay—lain，lying；说谎：lie—lied—lied；另一个动词 lay（放置）—laid—laid，需要宾语。lie in 在于；lie down 躺下。

P20level 7 meanings

level

1 n. 水平；程度；等级

A degree of amount, quality, or achievement.

Her English has reached an advanced level.
她的英语已达到较高水平。

2 n. 高度；楼层；液面

A position measured vertically, or a floor of a building.

Check the water level in the tank.
检查水箱里的水位。

3 adj. 平的；水平的；齐平的

Flat, horizontal, or at the same height.

Make sure the table is level.
确保桌面保持水平。

4 adj. 相等的；比分持平的

Equal in amount, score, or position.

The scores were level at half-time.
半场时比分持平。

5 v. 使平整；夷平

To make a surface flat or destroy a structure completely.

The old building was levelled.
那栋旧建筑被夷平了。

6 v. 瞄准；提出指责

To aim something, including criticism, at a target.

Criticism was levelled at the policy.
批评指向了这项政策。

7 n. 水平仪

A tool used to check whether a surface is horizontal.

Use a level to hang the shelf straight.
用水平仪把架子装平。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

at sea level 在海平面高度；a high level of 高水平的；level with 与……齐平、对……坦诚；level off 趋于稳定。

P21lot 5 meanings

lot

1 pron./adv. 大量；很；非常

A large amount or to a great degree.

I have learned a lot this term.
这学期我学到了很多。

2 n. 尤其美式 地块；场地

An area of land used for a particular purpose.

There is a parking lot behind the bank.
银行后面有一个停车场。

3 n. 一批；一组；全部某类东西

A group or quantity considered together.

This lot of books belongs upstairs.
这批书应该放在楼上。

4 n. 命运；处境

Someone's situation or share in life.

She tried to improve her lot.
她努力改善自己的处境。

5 n. 签；抽签所用物

An object used to make a random choice.

We drew lots to choose the first player.
我们抽签决定谁先开始。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a lot of 接可数复数或不可数名词；a lot 修饰动词或比较级；lots of 较口语。the lot 全部；draw lots 抽签。

P22ticket 6 meanings

ticket

1 n. 票；入场券；车票

A document or electronic record giving a right to enter or travel.

I booked a train ticket online.
我在网上订了一张火车票。

2 n. 罚单

An official notice requiring payment for an offence.

He got a ticket for speeding.
他因超速收到了一张罚单。

3 v. 开罚单；出票或贴标签

To issue a ticket or attach a ticket to something.

Cars parked here will be ticketed.
停在这里的车辆会被开罚单。

4 n. 达到目的的途径

A means of obtaining something desirable.

Education can be a ticket to a better future.
教育可以成为通往更好未来的途径。

5 n. 美式政治 候选人名单；政党竞选纲领

A party's candidates or the platform they stand on.

She ran on the same ticket as the governor.
她与州长候选人搭档竞选。

6 n. 标签；号码单；工单

A label or numbered record used to identify or track something.

Please open a support ticket.
请提交一张客服工单。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a ticket to/for 票；a ticket to success 成功的途径；a parking ticket 违停罚单；a support ticket 客服工单。

P23blow 6 meanings

blow

1 v. 吹；刮风；吹动

To move air or be moved by air.

The wind blew the door shut.
风把门吹关了。

2 v. 吹气；吹奏

To force air out of the mouth or through an instrument.

She blew out the candles.
她吹灭了蜡烛。

3 n. 击打；打击

A hit or a sudden harmful event.

The news was a serious blow to the team.
这个消息给团队造成了沉重打击。

4 v. 爆炸；熔断

To explode or stop working because of excess current.

A fuse blew during the storm.
暴风雨期间一个保险丝熔断了。

5 v. 非正式 浪费；搞砸

To waste money or ruin an opportunity.

He blew all his savings on a car.
他把全部积蓄都花在一辆车上了。

6 n. 吹气；擤鼻动作

An act of blowing air or clearing the nose.

Give your nose a good blow.
好好擤一下鼻子。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

blow—blew—blown；blow up 爆炸、充气或勃然大怒；blow out 吹灭；blow over 风波平息；blow one's nose 擤鼻涕。

P24dive 5 meanings

dive

1 v./n. 跳水；潜水

To jump into water or swim below its surface; such an activity.

She dived into the pool.
她跳进了游泳池。

2 v./n. 俯冲；扑向

To move suddenly downward or toward something.

The bird dived for a fish.
鸟俯冲下去捕鱼。

3 v./n. 骤降；暴跌

To fall suddenly in value or amount.

Share prices took a dive.
股价突然暴跌。

4 v. 短语 迅速投入；深入研究

To begin an activity eagerly or examine a subject deeply.

Let's dive into the details.
让我们深入看看细节。

5 n. 非正式 低档酒吧或场所

A cheap, unpleasant bar or similar place.

They met in a small dive near the station.
他们在车站附近一家简陋的小酒吧见了面。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

常规过去式 dived；美式也用 dove，过去分词通常 dived。dive into 投入、深入研究；take a dive 暴跌，也可在体育中指假摔或故意输。

P25material 6 meanings

material

1 n. 材料；原料

A substance used for making something.

The bridge is made of recycled material.
这座桥由再生材料制成。

2 n. 资料；素材；学习材料

Information or content used for study or creative work.

The teacher uploaded the reading materials.
老师上传了阅读资料。

3 adj. 物质的；实际生活的

Relating to physical things or possessions.

They value friendship more than material wealth.
他们看重友谊，胜过物质财富。

4 n. 布料；织物

Cloth used for clothes or other items.

This material is soft and light.
这种布料柔软轻薄。

5 adj. 正式 重要的；实质性的

Significant enough to affect a decision or situation.

The change made no material difference.
这个变化没有造成实质性差别。

6 n. 具备某种潜质的人

A person considered suitable for a particular role.

She is clearly leadership material.
她显然是当领导的料。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

材料通常不可数；某些原材料、用品用 materials。material to 与……有重大关系。material 作形容词是“物质的”或“重要的”。

P26reserve 6 meanings

reserve

1 v. 预订；保留

To arrange to keep something for future use.

I reserved a seat by the window.
我预订了一个靠窗座位。

2 v. 留出；专用于

To keep something for a particular person or purpose.

These spaces are reserved for disabled drivers.
这些车位专供残疾驾驶员使用。

3 n. 储备；储量；备用人员

A supply or group kept for future need.

The country has large gas reserves.
这个国家天然气储量很大。

4 n. 保护区

An area where wildlife or natural features are protected.

We visited a nature reserve.
我们参观了一处自然保护区。

5 n. 矜持；拘谨；克制

A tendency not to show feelings openly.

Her reserve was mistaken for unfriendliness.
她的矜持被误认为不友好。

6 n. 替补；后备军

A player or force available when needed.

He started the season as a reserve.
赛季开始时他是一名替补。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

reserve a room 预订房间；in reserve 留作备用；a nature reserve 自然保护区；without reserve 毫无保留。reserved 还可指拘谨的。

P27paper 6 meanings

paper

1 n. 纸；纸张

Thin sheets used for writing, printing, or wrapping.

Write your name on a piece of paper.
在一张纸上写下你的名字。

2 n. 论文；学术文章

A piece of academic writing or research.

She published a paper on language learning.
她发表了一篇关于语言学习的论文。

3 n. 报纸

A newspaper.

I read the paper every morning.
我每天早上读报。

4 n. 复数 文件；证件

Official documents identifying someone or recording something.

The officer checked our papers.
那名官员检查了我们的证件。

5 n. 试卷；考卷；考试科目

An examination or the written questions or answers in it.

The maths paper was difficult.
数学试卷很难。

6 v. 贴墙纸；用纸覆盖

To cover a wall or surface with paper.

They papered the bedroom walls.
他们给卧室墙壁贴了墙纸。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

纸张不可数：a piece/sheet of paper；论文、报纸、试卷可数：a paper。papers 还可指证件。on paper 在纸上或理论上。

P28practice 6 meanings

practice

1 n. 练习；训练

Repeated activity done to improve a skill.

Speaking English takes regular practice.
说英语需要经常练习。

2 v. 美式 练习；训练

To do something repeatedly to improve.

She practices playing the piano every day.
她每天练习弹钢琴。

3 n. 实践；实际应用

The actual use of an idea or method.

The theory sounds good, but does it work in practice?
这个理论听起来不错，但实际可行吗？

4 n. 惯例；习惯；做法

An established or usual way of doing something.

It is common practice to check references.
核实推荐材料是一种常见做法。

5 n. 专业业务；诊所或事务所

The work or business of a doctor, lawyer, or similar professional.

He opened a dental practice.
他开了一家牙科诊所。

6 v. 美式 从事专业；实行

To work in a profession or follow a belief or custom.

She practices law in London.
她在伦敦从事律师工作。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

英式名词 practice，动词 practise；美式两者均 practice。practice doing 练习做；in practice 实际上；put into practice 付诸实践。

P29port 5 meanings

port

1 n. 港口；港口城市

A place where ships load, unload, or shelter.

The ship arrived at the port at dawn.
船于黎明抵达港口。

2 n. 接口；端口

A connection point on a device or in a network.

Plug the cable into the USB port.
把电缆插入USB接口。

3 n./adj. 左舷；左舷的

The left side of a ship when facing forward.

The island was visible on the port side.
从左舷可以看到那座岛。

4 n. 波特酒

A strong sweet fortified wine associated with Portugal.

He ordered a glass of port.
他点了一杯波特酒。

5 v. 计算机 移植软件

To adapt software to run on another platform.

The game was ported to mobile devices.
这款游戏被移植到了移动设备上。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

port 港口，harbour 常指避风水域；USB port 接口；port side 左舷，starboard 右舷。港口与葡萄酒两个义项通常靠语境区分。

P30junior 4 meanings

junior

1 adj. 较年幼的；青少年的

Younger in age or intended for young people.

He joined the junior team.
他加入了少年队。

2 adj. 职位较低的；资历较浅的

Lower in rank or with less experience.

她是一名初级会计师。

3 n. 较年轻或资历较浅的人

A person younger or lower in rank than another.

He is three years my junior.
他比我小三岁。

4 n. 美式 高中或大学三年级学生

A student in the third year of a four-year high school or college programme.

She is a junior at college.
她是大学三年级学生。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

junior to 比……资历低（不用 than）；a junior employee 初级员工；美式大学 junior 通常为三年级学生。姓名后的 Junior/Jr. 表示同名的晚辈。

P31consider 4 meanings

consider

1 v. 考虑；仔细思考

To think carefully about something before deciding.

We are considering moving to another city.
我们正考虑搬到另一座城市。

2 v. 认为；把……看作

To have a particular opinion about someone or something.

我认为她是一个可靠的朋友。

3 v. 顾及；体谅

To take someone's needs or a fact into account.

Please consider how others might feel.
请顾及别人可能的感受。

4 v. 审议；研究；论述

To examine a subject formally or in detail.

The committee will consider the proposal tomorrow.
委员会明天将审议该提案。

consider doing 考虑做；consider sb/sth (to be) 认为……是；consider + 疑问词/从句。一般不说 consider to do 表示“考虑做”。

P32used 5 meanings

used

1 v. 过去式/过去分词 使用了；被使用

The past tense and past participle of use.

这个工具被用来切割金属。

Used with to and a verb for past habits or states.

我过去常步行上学。

3 adj. 短语 习惯于

Familiar with something through experience.

我习惯早起。

4 adj. 用过的；二手的

Previously owned or used by someone.

他买了一辆二手车。

5 adj. 被利用的；被当作工具的

Made to feel exploited by someone.

After the deal, she felt used.
交易之后，她觉得自己被利用了。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

used 作“二手的”读 /juːzd/；used to（过去常常）通常 /ˈjuːst tə/；be/get used to 后接名词或 doing；be used to do 表“被用来做”，结构不同。

P33zoom 4 meanings

zoom

1 v. 变焦；放大或缩小画面

To change the apparent size of an image by adjusting the view.

放大画面来阅读小字。

2 n. 变焦功能；快速移动

A change in image magnification or a rapid movement.

这台相机具有强大的光学变焦功能。

3 v. 疾驰；迅速移动

To move very quickly.

A motorbike zoomed past us.
一辆摩托车从我们身边疾驰而过。

4 v. 急剧增长；猛涨

To rise or increase rapidly.

Sales zoomed after the launch.
产品推出后销量猛增。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

zoom in/out 放大/缩小视图；zoom in on 聚焦或详细查看；Zoom 大写也可为软件品牌。zoom lens 变焦镜头。

P34cream 6 meanings

cream

1 n. 奶油；稀奶油

The rich fatty part of milk.

Would you like cream in your coffee?
你的咖啡要加奶油吗？

2 n. 乳霜；膏；糊状食品

A thick smooth substance used on the skin or in food.

Apply the cream to your hands.
把乳霜涂在手上。

3 n./adj. 奶油色；淡黄色（的）

A pale yellowish-white colour.

The room has cream walls.
房间的墙是奶油色的。

4 n. 精华；最优秀的人或物

The best people or things in a group.

The programme attracts the cream of young researchers.
这个项目吸引了青年研究者中的佼佼者。

5 v. 把黄油、糖等搅成乳脂状

To beat ingredients into a smooth creamy mixture.

Cream the butter and sugar together.
把黄油和糖一起搅打至细腻。

6 v. 非正式 轻松击败

To defeat someone very easily.

Their team got creamed in the final.
他们队在决赛中惨败。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

cream 奶油与 ice cream 冰淇淋区分；the cream of 精华；cream off 撇取上层、抽走最有价值部分；creamy 细腻柔滑的。

P35figure 7 meanings

figure

1 n. 数字；数值

A number or numerical amount.

The final figure was higher than expected.
最终数值比预期更高。

2 v. 认为；估计；计算

To think, estimate, or calculate.

I figured that he would arrive late.
我估计他会迟到。

3 n. 人物；重要人物

A person, especially someone notable.

She is a leading figure in education.
她是教育界的重要人物。

4 n. 身影；体形；轮廓

The shape of a person's body or a visible outline.

A dark figure stood at the gate.
一个黑色身影站在门口。

5 n. 图表；插图；几何图形

A diagram, illustration, or shape.

Figure three shows the results.
图三展示了结果。

6 n. 雕像；人形物

A representation of a person or animal.

A bronze figure stood in the square.
广场上矗立着一尊铜像。

7 v. 出现；占有重要地位

To appear or have a role in something.

Cost figures heavily in our decision.
费用在我们的决定中占很大分量。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

figure out 弄懂、算出；figure in 在……中起作用；public figure 公众人物；in round figures 用约数。figure 作“认为”较口语。

P36full 6 meanings

full

1 adj. 满的；装满的

Containing as much as possible.

The bus is full.
公交车满员了。

2 adj. 完整的；全部的

Complete, with nothing missing.

Please give your full name.
请填写你的全名。

3 adj. 饱的

Having eaten enough food.

I am full, thank you.
我吃饱了，谢谢。

4 adj. 最大程度的；充分的

At the greatest possible strength or extent.

The engine was running at full power.
发动机在全功率运行。

5 adj. 丰满的；宽松的；浓郁的

Large or rounded in shape, loose in cut, or rich in sound or flavour.

这位歌手的声音饱满温暖。

Directly or completely, often in fixed expressions.

The light shone full in my face.
光直接照在我脸上。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

be full of 充满；in full 全部地；to the full 充分地；full-time 全职的；full stop 英式“句号”。full 作饱的可用于人。

P37second 6 meanings

second

1 det./adj./adv. 第二（的）；其次

Coming immediately after the first.

She finished second in the race.
她在比赛中获得第二名。

2 n. 秒；片刻

A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute, or a short moment.

3 adj. 另一个的；额外的

Another of the same kind or an additional one.

我可以再来一杯吗？

To formally support a proposal made by someone else.

我附议这项动议。

An additional helping of food, or goods of imperfect quality.

6 v. 借调；临时派遣

To transfer an employee temporarily to another position.

她被借调到研究团队。

序数词第二、时间单位秒及动词支持都读 /ˈsekənd/；second 表“借调”通常重音在后，英 /sɪˈkɒnd/、美 /sɪˈkɑːnd/。second-hand 二手的、间接的。

P38sign 6 meanings

sign

1 n. 迹象；征兆

Something showing that a condition exists or may develop.

There was no sign of rain.
没有要下雨的迹象。

2 n. 标志；招牌；指示牌

A notice or symbol giving information.

Follow the signs to the exit.
沿着指示牌走向出口。

3 v. 签名；签署；签约

To write a name on a document or enter an agreement.

Please sign at the bottom of the form.
请在表格底部签名。

4 n. 符号；手势

A written mark or movement conveying meaning.

A plus sign means addition.
加号表示加法。

5 n. 星座

One of the twelve divisions of the zodiac.

What is your star sign?
你是什么星座？

6 v. 打手势；用手语交流

To communicate with gestures or sign language.

She signed that we should wait.
她打手势示意我们等待。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a sign of ……的迹象；sign up (for) 报名；sign in/out 签到/签退；sign for 签收。signal 常强调传递信号，sign 还可指自然迹象。

P39balance 5 meanings

balance

1 n./v. 平衡；保持平衡

A steady state without falling; to remain or keep steady.

He lost his balance and fell.
他失去平衡摔倒了。

2 n./v. 均衡；兼顾；权衡

A fair or suitable relationship between competing things.

She balances study with a part-time job.
她兼顾学习与兼职工作。

3 n. 账户余额；剩余款项

Money in an account or an amount still owed.

Please pay the remaining balance by Friday.
请在周五前付清余款。

4 v. 使收支相抵；核对账目

To make totals match or keep spending within income.

We need to balance the budget.
我们需要平衡预算。

5 n. 天平；衡器

An instrument used to compare or measure weight.

The sample was weighed on a laboratory balance.
样品用实验室天平称重。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

keep/lose one's balance 保持/失去平衡；on balance 总的来说；bank balance 银行余额；balance A against B 权衡；work-life balance 工作与生活平衡。

P40stress 4 meanings

stress

1 n./v. 心理压力；使焦虑

Mental pressure, or to feel or cause worry.

Exams can cause a lot of stress.
考试可能带来很大压力。

2 n./v. 强调；重视

Special importance given to something; to emphasize it.

The teacher stressed the need for practice.
老师强调了练习的必要性。

3 n./v. 重音；重读

Extra force given to a syllable or word.

The stress falls on the first syllable.
重音落在第一个音节上。

4 n./v. 应力；施压

Force within a material caused by an external load; to subject it to force.

The bridge must withstand heavy stress.
这座桥必须承受很大的应力。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

under stress 处于压力下；stress the importance of 强调……的重要性；stress on 某音节的重音；stressful 令人有压力的，stressed 感到压力的。

P41due 6 meanings

due

1 adj. 短语 由……引起的

Caused by something, used with to.

The delay was due to heavy traffic.
延误是交通拥堵造成的。

2 adj. 预定的；预计到达的

Expected or scheduled at a particular time.

The train is due to arrive at six.
火车预计六点到达。

3 adj. 到期应付的；应交的

Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.

The assignment is due on Friday.
作业周五截止。

4 adj. 应得的；适当的

Deserved or appropriate in the circumstances.

Give her the respect that is due to her.
给予她应得的尊重。

5 n. 常用复数 应得之物；会费

Something deserved, or regular membership payments.

Members must pay their annual dues.
会员必须缴纳年费。

6 adv. 正向某方向

Exactly in a compass direction.

The village lies due north of here.
村庄在这里的正北方。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

due to + 名词/doing 表原因；be due to do 预计或按安排将做；be due for 应当得到、该进行。be due to illness 是“因病”，be due to arrive 是“预计到达”。

P42wave 5 meanings

wave

1 n. 波浪；波；波动

A moving ridge of water or a disturbance carrying energy.

Large waves hit the shore.
巨浪拍打着海岸。

2 v. 挥手；挥动

To move a hand or object back and forth.

She waved goodbye from the window.
她从窗口挥手告别。

3 n. 一阵；一批；浪潮

A sudden increase or movement affecting many people.

A wave of excitement spread through the crowd.
一阵兴奋传遍了人群。

4 v. 起伏；飘动

To move in a flowing up-and-down motion.

Flags waved in the wind.
旗帜在风中飘扬。

5 n./v. 波浪卷；使卷曲

A curve in hair, or to make hair form curves.

Her hair falls in soft waves.
她的头发呈柔和的波浪状垂落。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

wave at/to 向……挥手；wave goodbye 挥手告别；a wave of 一波……；wave aside 对……置之不理。wave 与 waive（放弃权利）不同。

P43rank 6 meanings

rank

1 n. 等级；军衔；地位

A position in a hierarchy or system.

She rose to the rank of captain.
她升到了上尉军衔。

2 v. 排列名次；评为；名列

To place or be placed in an order of quality or importance.

The university ranks among the best.
这所大学跻身最优秀的大学之列。

3 n. 一排；一列

A row of people or things.

The soldiers stood in ranks.
士兵们列队站立。

4 n. 复数 某组织的成员；群体

The members of a group or organization.

He joined the ranks of professional writers.
他加入了职业作家的行列。

5 adj. 恶臭的；茂密杂生的

Having a strong unpleasant smell, or growing too thickly.

A rank smell came from the drain.
排水沟里传来一股恶臭。

6 adj. 十足的；极端的（多贬义）

Complete or extreme, usually in a bad sense.

That is rank hypocrisy.
那是十足的虚伪。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

rank first 排第一；rank A above B 把A排在B之前；the rank and file 普通成员；a taxi rank 英式出租车候客点。

P44runner 6 meanings

runner

1 n. 跑步者；赛跑选手

Someone who runs, especially as a sport.

She is a long-distance runner.
她是一名长跑运动员。

2 n. 参赛者；竞选者

A person or animal taking part in a race or contest.

There are six runners in the final.
决赛有六名选手。

3 n. 跑腿人员；传递消息或物品的人

Someone employed to carry messages or do small tasks.

He worked as a runner on a film set.
他在电影片场做跑腿工作。

4 n. 长条地毯；桌旗

A long narrow carpet or strip of decorative cloth.

A runner covered the hallway floor.
走廊地面铺着一条长地毯。

5 n. 植物学 匍匐茎

A horizontal plant stem that roots to form new plants.

Strawberry plants produce runners.
草莓植株会长出匍匐茎。

6 n. 滑行装置；抽屉滑轨

A support or track along which something slides.

The drawer slides smoothly on its runners.
抽屉沿着滑轨顺畅滑动。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

runner-up 亚军，复数 runners-up；front-runner 领先者；a long-distance runner 长跑运动员；runner 还可用于植物、家具和地毯。

P45attachment 6 meanings

attachment

1 n. 附件；附加文件

A file sent together with an electronic message.

Please open the attachment.
请打开附件。

2 n. 依恋；感情联系

A strong emotional bond with someone or something.

She has a deep attachment to her hometown.
她对家乡有深厚的感情。

3 n. 附属装置；配件

An extra part fitted to a tool or machine.

The vacuum cleaner has a brush attachment.
吸尘器配有一个刷头附件。

4 n. 连接；附着；连接处

The act of fastening something or the place where it joins.

Check the attachment of the cable to the wall.
检查电缆与墙壁的固定连接。

5 n. 临时派驻；借调

A temporary assignment to another department or organization.

He is on attachment to another department.
他正被临时派驻到另一个部门。

6 n. 法律 财产扣押

A legal process of seizing property to secure or satisfy a claim.

The court ordered the attachment of the debtor's property.
法院下令扣押债务人的财产。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

an email attachment 邮件附件；attachment to 对……的依恋；attachment theory 依恋理论。attach A to B 把A附在B上。

P46spring 6 meanings

spring

1 n. 春天；春季

The season between winter and summer.

The trees blossom in spring.
树木在春天开花。

2 n. 弹簧；发条

A coiled piece of metal that returns to its shape after pressure.

The mattress has broken springs.
床垫里的弹簧坏了。

3 v. 突然出现；源自

To appear quickly or originate from something.

New shops sprang up near the station.
车站附近迅速出现了许多新商店。

4 n. 泉；泉水源头

A place where water naturally flows from the ground.

The village gets water from a spring.
村庄从一眼泉中取水。

5 v./n. 跳跃；弹起；弹性

To jump or move suddenly; a jump or the ability to bounce.

The cat sprang onto the wall.
猫一下跳到了墙上。

6 v. 突然告知或出其不意地提出

To present something unexpected to someone.

They sprang a surprise test on us.
他们突然给我们来了一次测验。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

spring—sprang—sprung；spring up 涌现；spring from 源于；spring into action 突然行动；spring a surprise on sb 让某人大吃一惊。

P47live 8 meanings

live

1 v. /lɪv/ 居住；生活

To have a home in a place or spend one's life in a way.

I live in Guangzhou.
我住在广州。

2 v. /lɪv/ 活着；存活

To be alive or remain alive.

Some trees live for hundreds of years.
有些树能活数百年。

3 adj./adv. /laɪv/ 现场直播的；现场演出的；实时地

Broadcast, performed, or transmitted as it happens.

The concert will be broadcast live.
音乐会将进行现场直播。

4 v. /lɪv/ 靠……为生；继续存在

To support oneself or continue to exist in memory or effect.

Her memory lives on.
人们一直怀念着她。

5 adj. /laɪv/ 活的；有生命的

Alive rather than dead.

The market sells live fish.
市场出售活鱼。

6 adj. /laɪv/ 带电的

Carrying an electric current.

Do not touch the live wire.
不要碰那根带电的电线。

7 adj. /laɪv/ 当前有效的；仍待处理的

Currently operating, available, or under active consideration.

This is still a live issue for the committee.
这仍是委员会正在处理的问题。

8 adj. /laɪv/ 实弹的；未爆的

Containing an explosive charge that can still be fired or detonated.

The soldiers trained with live ammunition.
士兵使用实弹进行训练。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

动词 live /lɪv/，形容词/副词 live /laɪv/。live in 居住于；live on 靠……生活；live up to 不辜负；live a happy life 过幸福生活。

P48fork 4 meanings

fork

1 n. 餐叉；叉状工具

A tool with two or more pointed prongs.

Use a fork to eat the pasta.
用叉子吃意大利面。

2 n. 岔口；分叉处

A place where a road, river, or branch divides.

Take the left road at the fork.
在岔路口走左边的路。

3 v. 分叉；使成叉状

To divide into branches or separate routes.

The path forks near the lake.
小路在湖边分岔。

4 n./v. 计算机 分支副本；派生开发

A separate version made from existing code; to create such a version.

They forked the project to add new features.
他们从项目分出副本，以开发新功能。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a knife and fork 刀叉；a fork in the road 岔路口；fork out 非正式“大笔掏钱”；代码 fork 指从现有项目分出独立开发副本。

P49buck 5 meanings

buck

1 n. 非正式 美元；某些国家的一元钱

A dollar, especially in informal speech.

The ticket cost ten bucks.
票价是十美元。

2 n. 雄鹿；某些动物的雄性

A male deer, rabbit, or certain other animals.

A buck stood at the edge of the forest.
一只雄鹿站在森林边缘。

3 n. 固定表达 责任（pass the buck 等）

Responsibility, especially in expressions about avoiding it.

Stop passing the buck and make a decision.
别再推卸责任了，做个决定吧。

4 v. 反抗；逆着趋势行事

To resist authority or go against a trend.

The shop bucked the trend and increased sales.
这家店逆势而上，销量增加了。

5 v. 尥蹶子；猛然弓背跃起

For an animal to jump with its back arched and hind legs kicking.

The horse bucked and threw the rider.
马尥起蹶子，把骑手摔了下来。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a buck 非正式“一美元”；pass the buck 推卸责任；buck the trend 逆势而行；buck up 振作起来。雄鹿常见，雌鹿常称 doe。

P50image 5 meanings

image

1 n. 图像；影像；映像

A visual representation, photograph, or reflected likeness.

The mirror produced a clear image.
镜子映出了清晰的影像。

2 n. 形象；公众印象

The general impression others have of a person or organization.

The company wants to improve its image.
公司希望改善自身形象。

3 n. 心像；脑海中的画面

A picture formed in the mind.

The story created a vivid image in my mind.
这个故事在我脑海中形成了生动的画面。

4 n. 比喻意象

A word or description that creates a vivid comparison or picture.

The poem uses images of light and darkness.
这首诗运用了光明与黑暗的意象。

5 v. 成像；制作映像

To produce a picture or digital copy of something.

The scanner images the inside of the body.
扫描仪对人体内部进行成像。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

image of ……的图像或印象；public image 公众形象；mental image 脑海中的画面；be the image of 与……十分相像。image 不等同于 imagination 想象力。

P51universal 4 meanings

universal

1 adj. 普遍的；全体共同的

Existing everywhere or shared by everyone in a group.

The desire for safety is universal.
对安全的渴望是普遍的。

2 adj. 全世界的；全人类的

Relating to the whole world or all people.

The declaration sets out universal human rights.
该宣言阐明了普遍人权。

3 adj. 通用的；多用途的

Suitable for many different uses or systems.

This is a universal remote control.
这是一个通用遥控器。

4 n. 哲学等 普遍概念；共相

A general property or concept shared by particular things.

The course examines the problem of universals.
这门课探讨共相问题。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

universal access 人人可及；universal agreement 普遍共识；universal truth 普遍真理；universal charger 通用充电器。“普遍”有时是概括，并非精确统计的所有。

P52strain 7 meanings

strain

1 n. 负担；紧张；压力

Pressure that stretches someone's resources or endurance.

The extra work put a strain on her.
额外工作给她造成了负担。

2 v./n. 拉伤；损伤

To injure a muscle by stretching it too much; such an injury.

He strained a muscle in his back.
他拉伤了背部肌肉。

3 n. 品种；菌株；类型

A variety of an organism or a particular type.

Researchers identified a new strain of the virus.
研究人员识别出一种新的病毒株。

4 v. 竭力；用力拉；使紧张

To make a great effort or stretch something tightly.

I strained to hear the announcement.
我竭力听清广播。

5 v. 过滤；滤去

To separate liquid from solids using a filter.

Strain the soup before serving.
上桌前把汤过滤一下。

6 n. 常用复数 乐曲的旋律；片段

The sound of a tune or passage of music.

We heard the strains of a violin.
我们听到了小提琴的旋律。

7 n. 技术 应变；相对形变量

Deformation measured relative to original size.

The gauge measures strain in the metal.
仪器测量金属中的应变。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

strain 与 stress 有重叠；材料力学中 stress 是应力，strain 是应变。strain a muscle 拉伤肌肉；put a strain on 给……造成负担。

P53bound 7 meanings

bound

1 adj. 必定会；很可能会

Certain or very likely to do something, used with to.

You are bound to make mistakes at first.
你刚开始很可能会犯错。

2 adj. 开往；前往某地的

Travelling toward a particular destination.

This train is bound for Beijing.
这列火车开往北京。

3 v. bind过去式/过去分词 捆绑；装订；使结合

Tied, fastened, or joined, as a form of bind.

The books were bound in leather.
这些书用皮革装订。

4 adj. 有义务的；受约束的

Required by duty, law, or an agreement.

We are bound by the contract.
我们受合同约束。

5 n. 常用复数 界限；限度

A limit or boundary.

His enthusiasm knows no bounds.
他的热情无穷无尽。

6 v./n. 跳跃；跃步

To move with large jumps; a long jump.

The dog bounded across the field.
狗蹦跳着穿过田野。

7 v. 构成边界；限制范围

To form a boundary around something.

The garden is bounded by a low wall.
花园以一道矮墙为界。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

bound 有多个来源：bind—bound—bound（捆绑）；bound 作跳跃用规则变化 bounded；be bound to do 必定/很可能；be bound for 前往；be bound by 受约束。

P54band 6 meanings

band

1 n. 乐队；乐团

A group of musicians who perform together.

She plays guitar in a band.
她在一个乐队里弹吉他。

2 n. 带；环；条带

A strip or loop of material.

She tied the papers with a rubber band.
她用橡皮筋捆住文件。

3 n. 一伙；一群

A group of people sharing an activity or purpose.

A band of volunteers cleaned the beach.
一群志愿者清理了海滩。

4 n. 范围；频段；等级

A range of values, frequencies, or categories.

The job falls within a higher pay band.
这份工作属于较高的薪酬等级。

5 n. 色带；条纹

A stripe of colour or contrasting material.

The snake has yellow bands.
这条蛇身上有黄色条纹。

6 v. 用带捆扎；联合

To fasten with a band or join together as a group.

Local families banded together to help.
当地家庭联合起来提供帮助。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a rock band 摇滚乐队；a band of 一群；a rubber band 橡皮筋；band together 联合起来；bandwidth 带宽。

P55line 9 meanings

line

1 n. 线；线条；细纹

A long narrow mark, edge, or wrinkle.

Draw a straight line.
画一条直线。

2 n. 一行文字；一句台词

A row of written words or a sentence spoken in a play.

The actor forgot his lines.
那位演员忘词了。

3 n. 队列；一排

A row of people or things, especially a queue.

We waited in line for tickets.
我们排队等着买票。

4 n. 线路；航线；电话连接

A route or connection for transport or communication.

The phone line is busy.
电话占线。

5 n. 边界；界线；立场

A dividing boundary or a position taken on an issue.

The river marks the line between the two regions.
这条河是两个地区的分界线。

6 n. 行业；系列；产品线

A field of work or range of related products.

The company launched a new line of shoes.
公司推出了一个新的鞋类系列。

7 n. 绳；钓鱼线；血统

A length of cord, or a chain of descent.

His family line goes back centuries.
他的家族血统可追溯数百年。

8 v. 沿……排列

To form a row along the edge or sides of something.

Trees line both sides of the road.
道路两旁树木成行。

9 v. 给……加衬里；铺在内部

To cover the inside of something with a layer of material.

Line the tin with baking paper.
在烤模内铺上烘焙纸。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

in line 排队；on the line 在线上、面临风险；in line with 与……一致；line up 排队；draw the line 划清界限；bottom line 底线或最终结果。

P56lean 7 meanings

lean

1 v. 倾斜；倚靠

To bend from an upright position or rest against something.

He leaned against the wall.
他倚靠着墙。

2 v. 短语 依靠；对……施压

To depend on someone or pressure them, used with on.

你可以依靠朋友获得支持。

3 v. 倾向于

To be inclined toward an opinion or choice.

I lean towards the cheaper option.
我倾向于较便宜的方案。

4 adj. 瘦而结实的；脂肪少的

Thin and fit, or containing little fat.

做这道菜要选瘦肉。

5 adj. 精简高效的

Using only necessary resources and avoiding waste.

They run a lean organization.
他们管理着一个精简高效的组织。

6 adj. 匮乏的；不景气的

Having little money, food, or other resources.

The family faced several lean years.
这家人度过了几年拮据的日子。

7 n. 倾斜；倾向

An inclination in position or preference.

The tower has a noticeable lean.
这座塔明显倾斜。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

lean—leaned/leant；lean against 靠着；lean toward(s) 倾向于；lean on 倚靠、依赖，也可指施压。lean meat 瘦肉；lean management 精益管理。

P57post 7 meanings

post

1 n. 帖子；发布的内容

An item published on a website or social platform.

I read your latest post.
我看了你最新的帖子。

2 n. 职位；岗位；驻地

A job or a place where someone is assigned to work.

He accepted a teaching post.
他接受了一个教师职位。

3 n. 邮政；邮件

The system of sending letters or the letters delivered.

The parcel arrived in the morning post.
包裹随早上的邮件送到了。

4 v. 邮寄；发布

To send by mail or publish information publicly.

She posted a message online.
她在网上发布了一条消息。

5 n. 柱；杆；门柱

An upright piece of wood or metal.

The ball hit the goalpost.
球击中了球门柱。

6 v. 派驻；部署；张贴

To assign someone to a place or display a notice.

A guard was posted at the entrance.
入口处安排了一名警卫。

7 v. 商业 公布业绩；记账

To report financial results or enter a transaction in an account.

公司公布今年实现盈利。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

post a letter 寄信（英式）；a job post 职位；post a message 发消息；keep sb posted 让某人随时了解情况；post-war 战后的（post- 前缀“之后”）。

P58quarter 7 meanings

quarter

1 n. 四分之一；一刻钟

One of four equal parts, or fifteen minutes.

班里四分之一的学生缺席。

2 n. 季度；比赛的一节

A three-month business period or one of four parts of a game.

第一季度销售额增长了。

3 n. 美式 二十五美分硬币

A coin worth twenty-five cents.

这台机器接收二十五美分硬币。

4 n. 城区；区域；某一方面的人士

A district of a town, or a source of opinion or support.

我们步行穿过老城区。

5 n. 复数 住处；营房

Rooms or buildings used as accommodation.

员工宿舍在酒店后面。

6 v. 把……分成四份；为……安排住宿

To divide into four parts or provide accommodation.

Quarter the apples before cooking.
烹煮前把苹果切成四块。

7 n. 正式/历史 饶命；宽恕

Mercy shown to a defeated opponent.

The commander ordered his men to give no quarter.
指挥官命令士兵不要饶恕敌人。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

a quarter of 四分之一；a quarter past six 六点一刻；a quarter to six 差一刻六点；quarters 表住所，headquarters 总部。

bug

1 n. 口语 小虫子

A minor illness caused by an infection.

To annoy someone, especially repeatedly.

5 n./v. 窃听器；安装窃听器

A hidden listening device, or to put one in a place.

他们在桌子下面发现了一个窃听器。

Collocations, grammar & usage notes

fix a bug 修复程序错误；a stomach bug 常指引起肠胃不适的感染；stop bugging me 是口语“别烦我了”。

P60forward 5 meanings

forward

Located near the front of something.

instrument

An asset or agreement with financial value that can often be traded.

tuck A into B 表示把 A 塞进 B；tuck someone in 表示给某人掖好被子。英式口语 tuck into a meal 表示痛快地吃起来。

To move or close suddenly with a sharp sound.

Limits or guidelines that determine what is allowed or possible.

通常用复数 parameters 指规则或界限；within the parameters of the study 表示在研究范围内。数学或程序设计中，parameter 可指决定系统行为的参数，不等同于任何会变化的数值。

P74tone 6 meanings

tone

1 n. 语气；口吻

The attitude expressed by the way someone speaks or writes.

2 n. 音色；音调

A quality or pitch of a sound.

The general mood or character of a piece of writing or an event.

P75pattern 4 meanings

pattern

1 n. 模式；规律；行为方式

A repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

A repeated arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours.

A design or shape used as a guide for making something.

To design or make something by following a model.

pattern 可指反复出现的规律或图案；trend 强调变化方向，habit 强调习惯，model 可指模型或范例。pattern A on/after B 表示以 B 为模仿对象。

PART 04 · PHRASES

01 over time

over time

As time passes; gradually over a period of time.

随着时间的推移；逐渐

Usage

Describes a gradual change or development. It can appear at the beginning or end of a sentence.

强调变化在一段时间内逐渐发生，常与 improve、change、develop、increase、decrease 等动词搭配，可放在句首或句末。

Common combinations

improve over time · change over time · develop over time

Examples

Your English will improve over time.

随着时间的推移，你的英语会逐渐进步。

Over time, small changes can make a big difference.

随着时间的推移，微小的变化也能带来很大的影响。

The pattern becomes clearer over time.

随着时间的推移，这个规律变得更加清晰。

Usage notes

Over time describes gradual change; in time means early enough or eventually; on time means at the scheduled time. Overtime (one word) means extra working time or extra time in a sports match.

over time 强调“随时间逐渐变化”；in time 表示“及时”或“最终”；on time 表示“准时”。注意 overtime 连写是另一个词，表示“加班（时间）”或“加时赛”。

02 in full bloom

in full bloom

With flowers fully open; also at a highly developed stage.

盛开；处于全盛期

Usage

Often follows be or come.

常接在 be 后面，形容花盛开，也可用于比喻。

Common combinations

be in full bloom · roses in full bloom

Examples

The cherry trees are in full bloom.

樱花树正在盛开。

Usage notes

In bloom means flowering; full adds the idea of the peak flowering stage.

in bloom 是开花；full 强调盛开。

03 make a difference

make a difference

To have an effect on someone or something.

产生影响；起作用

Usage

Use make a difference to someone or something.

常用 make a difference to，形容带来影响或改变。

Common combinations

make a big difference · make a difference to

Examples

A short break can make a difference to your concentration.

短暂休息可以改善你的专注力。

Usage notes

A difference between two things means a distinction; make a difference means to have an effect.

a difference between 指差别；make a difference 指产生影响。

04 at risk of

at risk of

In danger of experiencing something harmful.

有……的风险

Usage

Follow of with a noun or an -ing form.

of 后接名词或动名词。

Common combinations

at risk of burnout · at risk of losing

Examples

They are at risk of losing their jobs.

他们面临失业的风险。

Usage notes

At risk means in danger; take a risk means to do something despite uncertainty.

at risk 指处于风险中；take a risk 指冒险。

05 as opposed to

as opposed to

Used to contrast one choice or situation with another.

而不是；与……相对

Usage

Follow to with a noun phrase or an -ing form.

这里 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

Common combinations

working as opposed to resting · quality as opposed to quantity

Examples

The course focuses on practice as opposed to theory.

这门课程侧重实践而非理论。

Usage notes

Opposed to can mean against; as opposed to introduces a contrast.

be opposed to 可指反对；as opposed to 用于对照。

06 make the most of

make the most of

To use an opportunity or resource as effectively as possible.

充分利用

Usage

Use with time, opportunities, or available resources.

常与时间、机会或已有资源搭配。

Common combinations

make the most of your time · make the most of an opportunity

Examples

Make the most of your time off.

充分利用你的休假时间。

Usage notes

Make the most of does not mean make the majority of something.

这是固定表达，不是“制作其中的大多数”。

07 think twice about

think twice about

To consider carefully before making a decision.

对……三思；慎重考虑

Usage

Follow about with a noun or an -ing form.

about 后接名词或动名词；常暗示行动前应谨慎。

Common combinations

think twice about accepting · think twice about a decision

Examples

Think twice about sending work emails at midnight.

深夜发送工作邮件前要三思。

Usage notes

Think twice before doing is another common construction.

也常用 think twice before doing。

08 differ from

differ from

To be different from someone or something.

与……不同

Usage

Use a full clause at the start, or an -ing clause with the same understood subject as the main clause.

可置于句首，但须结构完整。differ 是谓语动词，不能直接写 Differ from X, ...；分词结构可用 Differing from X, ...，且逻辑主语须与主句主语一致。differing 是 differ 的 -ing 形式，也可修饰名词，表示不同的，如 differing opinions。

Common combinations

differ from someone in something · differ in size · differing opinions

Examples

How does this method differ from the old one?

这个方法与旧方法有什么不同？

Differing from the earlier model in size, this model fits smaller desks.

这款型号的尺寸与旧款不同，适合较小的桌子。

We have differing opinions on the proposal.

我们对这项提议有不同看法。

Usage notes

For a simpler contrast, write Unlike the earlier model, this model is smaller. Different from can describe the subject too. Avoid a dangling modifier.

更简洁可说 Unlike the earlier model, this model is smaller. 或 Different from the earlier model, this model ...。不要写 Differing from the old model, the price is lower. 来比较型号，因为该句的主语变成了 price。

09 spur someone on / spur someone into action

spur someone on / spur someone into action

To encourage someone to keep trying or cause someone to take action.

激励某人继续努力；促使某人行动

Usage

Use spur someone on, spur someone to do something, or spur someone into action.

spur 强调刺激或推动行动；这里按短语收录。代词放在 spur 与 on 之间，如 spur them on。

Common combinations

spur someone on · spur someone to do something · spur someone into action

Examples

Her encouragement spurred me on.

她的鼓励激励我继续努力。

The setback spurred him to work harder.

这次挫折促使他更加努力。

The warning spurred them into action.

这条警告促使他们采取行动。

Usage notes

Spur can also take a thing as its object, as in spur growth. Spur of the moment belongs to the separate expression on the spur of the moment.

也可直接接事物，如 spur growth（促进增长）。on the spur of the moment 是一时冲动、临时起意，不能把 spur on 译成这个意思。
